items.summary: Disposition: blocked for public launch and security-sensitive releases; conditional for ordinary reversible growth that preserves existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, platform-policy, and data boundaries. Evidence: Woot redistribution rights are unproven; four SearchWoot launch-readiness tasks remain open; security controls are unevidenced; compliance baseline is technical only with 36 pass, 17 fail, and 6 unknown; analytics quality is yellow; Amazon revenue is aggregate and unattributed. Keep SearchWoot private and preview-only. No go-live proposal is supported.

Progress: 0 of 4 SearchWoot launch-readiness tasks are closed and 4 remain open. Existing API, terms, support, repository, privacy, cookie-policy, and draft-terms artifacts are partial evidence only. Do not close tasks without direct evidence. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only bundle containing the field-level rights matrix, deployed data-flow and retention table, log/vendor/incident inventory, consent and GA4 configuration evidence, accuracy/freshness controls, and rollback evidence. Keep rights outreach unsent pending human-counsel review and owner authorization.

Woot API deal and price-history data: blocked. User alert rules and sync results: evidence_needed. GA4 analytics: evidence_needed. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data: evidence_needed. The smallest next actions are respectively: complete the internal counsel packet and obtain human-counsel review; produce a read-only deployed/repository data-flow and retention table; capture consent and GA4 configuration evidence without enabling tracking; produce a read-only log, vendor, incident, and request-procedure inventory.

Compliance scan results are a technical baseline, not certification: 36 sites pass, 17 fail, and 6 are unknown, with open banner, consent, GA4, privacy, and terms findings. Repair evidenced failures and investigate unknowns by site; do not treat missing telemetry as zero or as proof of noncompliance. Analytics has source-permission or collector errors and revenue covers only 2026-09-21: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission that cannot be assigned to a site. Preserve site revenue, ROI, margin, forecasts, and causal lift as unknown.

Keep complicated.work, deadlymaracas.com, and driveford.net parked, private, and preview-only. The required next evidence action is one dated readiness packet per site covering execution ownership, preview/build evidence, compliance, security, measurement boundary, rollback point, and explicit blocker. No publish, deploy, DNS change, analytics configuration, monetization, spend, dependency addition, or queue entry is cleared.

Maintain containment-only execution. Continue existing measurement, repair-or-close, finance reconciliation, security evidence, compliance evidence, and parked-site readiness work. Do not admit new queue work, requeue unchanged failures, deploy, spend, expand telemetry, add dependencies, expand monetization, or conduct rights outreach. The next evidence action is for delivery-lead to complete or justifiably close one existing failed or stranded item with dated ownership, isolated validation, rollback, release/security, attribution, measurement, and deduplication evidence.
